points.what: Search traffic contributed -44 orders to this week's change, the largest negative contributor with a 293.3% share of the change.
points.so_what: The WoW order dip was mainly pulled down by Search, even though the week finished ahead of target overall.

points.what: LATAM orders contributed -30 to this week's change, the largest negative regional contributor with a 200% share of the change.
points.so_what: The WoW order dip was concentrated in one region rather than spread evenly across regions.

points.what: Organic traffic contributed +28 to this week's change, the largest positive contributor among traffic sources.
points.so_what: Organic growth partly offset the pullback in Search, keeping the overall order decline smaller than the Search drop alone.

points.what: AOV rose 3.5% week on week and 4.0% year on year, both notable moves, while orders fell 1.5% week on week.
points.so_what: This week's revenue growth came from a higher average order value rather than more orders.

points.what: Cancellation rate fell 1.7 pp week on week to 14.5%, a notable improvement rated good.
points.so_what: Lower cancellations helped drive this week's revenue outperformance against target.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the week of 1 Jun 2026 was 9.4%, up 0.1 pp week on week and up 0.2 pp year on year.
points.so_what: Rising returns run counter to the improvement in cancellations, a mixed signal on order quality this week.

summary.headline: Orders and revenue both finished ahead of target this week, but year-to-date revenue remains behind target at 96.3%, needing a faster pace than the recent run-rate.

points.what: Orders were 106.9% of target and revenue was 113.6% of target this week.
points.so_what: This keeps the quarter close to target, with QTD revenue at 100.1% of target with one week left in Q2.

points.what: Revenue rose 4.0% week on week while orders fell 1.5% week on week, a notable move for revenue.
points.so_what: The week's revenue growth came from a higher average order value rather than more orders.

points.what: Orders grew 84.6% year on year and revenue grew 92.4% year on year, both above the 75% growth assumed in this year's targets.
points.so_what: This pace of year-on-year growth is consistent with a week that finished ahead of target.

points.what: New signups fell 11.4% year on year and 0.4% week on week.
points.so_what: Signups remain the weak point despite the week finishing ahead of target on both orders and revenue.

points.what: Orders were 106.9% of target and revenue was 113.6% of target this week.
points.so_what: Both figures ahead of target are what keep the quarter attainment near target despite earlier weeks lagging.

points.what: QTD revenue is 100.1% of target with one week left in the quarter, needing $72,160 more to reach the full-quarter target.
points.so_what: With just one week remaining, the quarter's final result depends on reaching this remaining amount.

points.what: YTD revenue is 96.3% of target, with a required weekly run-rate of $84,333 for the rest of the year versus a recent 8-week run-rate of $70,390.
points.so_what: The recent pace is below what's needed, so the full-year target requires a faster pace than achieved lately.

points.what: The required weekly revenue run-rate for the rest of 2026 is $84,333, above the current 8-week run-rate of $70,390.
points.so_what: At the recent pace, the full-year revenue target is out of reach.

points.what: New signups fell 0.4% week on week and 11.4% year on year, both rated declines.
points.so_what: This is a risk to future order growth even though orders are currently ahead of target.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the week of 1 Jun 2026 was 9.4%, up 0.1 pp week on week and up 0.2 pp year on year, both rated bad.
points.so_what: Returns are trending upward, a risk to watch on order quality even as cancellations improved this week.
